description: Create and optionally publish a post for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, etc. Supports post copy text, image attachments (Base64 data or URLs), and video. When publishNow is true, the post is published immediately to the social accounts (available to admin-approved users). Without publishNow or scheduledAt, it is saved as a draft.

body.description: Post copy text (optional if media attachments are provided)

channelIds.description: Destination channel UUIDs or platform names (e.g. ['linkedin', 'instagram', 'facebook'])

mediaData.description: Array of Base64 image/video data strings or data URIs to directly upload to storage and attach to this post

mediaIds.description: Array of media asset UUIDs returned by upload_media, import_media, or list_media

mediaUrls.description: Array of image or video URLs to automatically import to storage and attach to this post

publishNow.description: If true, queues the post for immediate publication to destination channels now instead of saving as draft (requires admin-approved MCP publishing access)

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp to schedule the post (e.g. '2026-09-21T11:00:00Z'). Without this or publishNow, saves as a draft.

name: create_post

outputSchema.description: Created post draft or queue entry

title: Create post
